capabilities: Move completed checkboxes into a completed section at the bottom of the note
Return un-ticked tasks from the completed section to the active list
Autocomplete tasks from anywhere in the note while typing in a checkbox
Delete a checkbox line via a hover × button
Stamp completed tasks with a configurable Moment.js date
disambiguation: Despite the name, it only reorders checkbox task lists; other lines, headings, and lists are left alone.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later; older versions are pointed to the 1.1.7 release.
problem: Completed checkboxes stay in place inside lists, so finished items clutter active tasks and there is no built-in way to archive or quickly remove them.
summary: A checkbox-list manager that moves completed tasks into a completed section, autocompletes tasks while typing, and deletes tasks in one click.
